meta.source: desktop/design/tokens.json (gt1-tone-matcher repo); app CSS generated by desktop/scripts/build-tokens.mjs
meta.concept: Signal Path: the interface follows the guitar signal (song → analysis → patch chain → unit). Quiet graphite and cream chrome; the only color lives in the effect chain, one enclosure color per GT-1 block.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Window background, behind the rail and every card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the rail, the console bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, menus, toasts and anything lifted above a card.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: inputs, meters, knob tracks, the patch-name LCD.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between groups and card edges. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, switches). 3:1 on surface and well.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions, field labels.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, scale ticks. 4.5:1 on surface and well.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Knob cream in Stage, amp tolex in Daylight: the one main action per view, the selected slot, the active step. Fill only; text on it uses on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a primary fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selected-but-not-primary fills: chosen segment, target slot, active nav item. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset. Blue so it never reads as a selection.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Written and verified, in tune, connected. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success notice or toast; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look, nothing failed: BTS open, unsure reading, demo mode. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning notice; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or destructive: errors, overwrite, stop. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error notice; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: The recording LED and the rec dot in calibration. Small marks only.

tokens.name: pedal-od
tokens.usage: OD/DS enclosure (the orange distortion box).

tokens.name: pedal-preamp
tokens.usage: PREAMP block: the amp's cream faceplate.

tokens.name: pedal-fx1
tokens.usage: FX1 enclosure (compressor, pitch shifter: the yellow box).

tokens.name: pedal-fx2
tokens.usage: FX2 enclosure (modulation: the violet box).

tokens.name: pedal-delay
tokens.usage: DELAY enclosure (the teal box).

tokens.name: pedal-reverb
tokens.usage: REVERB enclosure (the blue box).

tokens.name: on-pedal
tokens.usage: Text and knob marks on any enclosure color (4.5:1 on all six).

tokens.name: pedal-edge
tokens.usage: 1px enclosure edge: gives light-theme pedals their 3:1 boundary.

tokens.name: viz-song
tokens.usage: The song's measurement in comparisons and the first tone's lane on the song map.

tokens.name: viz-you
tokens.usage: Your playing in comparisons and the CTL-on tone's lane on the song map.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: console-bg
tokens.usage: The output console: dark in both themes, like the unit's screen.

tokens.name: console-ink
tokens.usage: Console text.

tokens.name: console-dim
tokens.usage: Console stderr and library noise.

tokens.name: console-cmd
tokens.usage: The echoed command line.

tokens.name: console-ok
tokens.usage: Console success line.

tokens.name: console-err
tokens.usage: Console error line.

styles.name: stage
styles.usage: Stage mode only: the tuner's note, the calibration countdown. Read from two meters away.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the page question or the song title on a result.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field and group labels, sentence case, ink-muted.

styles.name: param
styles.usage: GT-1 parameter and block names only (GAIN, OD/DS, FX1): uppercase because the unit prints them so.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Slot numbers, knob values, times: every number the GT-1 shows.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: The slot a patch went to; big meter values.

styles.name: patch-name
styles.usage: GT-1 patch names (16 characters) on the LCD well, as the unit shows them.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Kayıttaki gitarları ayırır, her tonu ayrı dinler.
styles.usage: The one explanatory paragraph under a page question.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Gitarını EADGBE akortla, pitch shifter yok.
styles.usage: All running text and control text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Values that matter inside running text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, LED to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and compact controls; gap in button rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to control; gap between knobs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding; separation of major regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state and stage-mode breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, keycaps, slot cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, the console, pedal enclosures.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: LEDs, switches, status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards: a lit top edge, almost no drop.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Sunken controls and meters.

tokens.name: shadow-pedal
tokens.usage: Pedal enclosures: painted metal with a bevel.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, toasts, menus.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggles.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Segmented thumb, knob arc, drawer.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets and the result reveal; the one orchestrated moment.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving between two places (needles, thumbs).
